actions.name: start
actions.description: Start a family trivia game, with you as the host ("let's play trivia", "trivia with Sam and Dad"). Read out what it answers: the first question and its choices.

players.description: Who's playing, by name, separated by commas; leave out for the whole family

questions.description: How many questions, if they said (10 if not)

actions.name: answer
actions.description: A player's answer to the trivia question on the screen, as its letter ("Sam says B", "I think it's the Pacific" from Dad: give the letter of that choice). Read out what it answers.

actions.name: next
actions.description: On to the next trivia question ("next", "next question"). Read out what it answers.

actions.name: reveal
actions.description: Show the answer to the trivia question now, before everyone has answered. Read out what it answers.

actions.name: repeat
actions.description: Read the trivia question and its choices again. Read out what it answers.

actions.name: score
actions.description: The trivia scores so far ("who's winning?"). Say what it answers.

actions.name: end
actions.description: End the trivia game now. Say what it answers.
